opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin as a worldwide financial opportunity, stating that “Millions of people around the world are mining OneCoin today.” It gives strong safety and audit assurances, including the unqualified claim that “mining the coin transferring money and making payments with Onetcoin is absolutely safe.” It also links participation with depositing money and saving over 80%, presenting the offer as an accessible financial revolution rather than warning viewers or critically examining its claims. The closing call to “join the financial revolution” and the supplied OneLife signup destination direct viewers toward participation. Taken together, these assurances, promised savings, mining opportunity, and signup invitation encourage engagement with the OneCoin ecosystem as a favorable financial proposition.
